candidates.summary: the branch the ADR calls the protection for every registered user has no test
candidates.failure_scenario: The ADR's last consequence states: "A last line that is neither `(true bool)` nor `(false bool)` is an error, not a 'no': if ResolveName ever changes shape, that must surface instead of quietly 404ing every registered user." The five evalFunc stubs in handler_http_test.go (lines 2055, 2076, 2099, 2135, 2158) return only parseable payloads or errors, so userExists' default branch never runs under test. Let ResolveName gain a return value, or UserData render across two lines, and the last qeval line stops matching; an edit that softens that default to `return false, nil` -- the exact outcome the ADR names -- leaves `go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/...` green, and every registered user who owns no packages 404s in silence.
candidates.verify_by: grep -n 'evalFunc:' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/handler_http_test.go returns 5 stubs, none producing an unparseable payload; then mutate handler_http.go:575 to `return false, nil` and run `go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestHTTPHandler_GetUserView` -- green proves the branch is uncovered. The missing case: an evalFunc returning []byte("(nil *gno.land/r/sys/users.UserData)") (no trailing bool line) with an assertion of 500, not 404.
candidates.evidence: grep -n 'evalFunc:' -> 2055 (unknown/renamed/no-registry table), 2076 (registered, resolveNamePayload(true)), 2099 (address, asserts never called), 2135 (invalid names, asserts never called), 2158 (ErrClientTimeout). grep for 'unexpected ResolveName' in the test file: no hit.

candidates.summary: a node answering "package not found" for r/sys/users is read as "not a user", and the gnodev case it cites does not need it
candidates.failure_scenario: userExists maps ErrClientPackageNotFound to (false, nil) with a Debug log, so any node-side condition that makes gno.land/r/sys/users unresolvable -- a node restored below the registry's deploy height, a chain-domain mismatch in rpcClient.Eval's assembled data, the registry moved -- 404s every registered user who owns no packages, for as long as a crawler remembers it. That is the harm the sibling timeout branch was written to prevent ("a 404 published on a blip deletes a real user's page"). The ADR justifies the branch as "the gnodev case", but gnodev deploys the registry by default: contribs/gnodev/app_config.go:127 documents `-no-examples` as "skip loading $GNOROOT/examples entirely" (opt-out), and contribs/gnodev/pkg/dev/node.go:449-452 injects the gno.land/r/sys/users/init.Bootstrap tx when that realm is loaded. So on a default gnodev ResolveName answers, and the silent branch is live only for a fault.
candidates.verify_by: read contribs/gnodev/app_config.go:127-129 and contribs/gnodev/pkg/dev/node.go:449-452 -- examples, and with them r/sys/users, load unless -no-examples is passed. Then decide whether ErrClientPackageNotFound from vm/qeval should stay a 404 or surface like every other node fault (the `case err != nil` line below it).
candidates.evidence: contribs/gnodev/app_config.go:129 "skip loading $GNOROOT/examples entirely"; contribs/gnodev/pkg/dev/node.go:449 `const usersInitPkgPath = "gno.land/r/sys/users/init"`, :452 "the r/sys/users/init.Bootstrap call is injected only when the [realm is loaded]".

candidates.summary: the cost table counts RPCs, not work: every unknown /u/<name> now builds a VM machine and evaluates Gno
candidates.failure_scenario: The description's table reads "unknown name: 2 before, 2 after", and the ADR adds that the qeval is "the heavier of the two shapes". What it costs is a machine: withQueryEvalMachine (gno.land/pkg/sdk/vm/keeper.go) returns ErrInvalidPkgPath at `pv == nil` for the absent package the replaced vm/qrender was asked about, but for r/sys/users -- which exists -- it allocates the gas meter and allocator, builds gno.NewMachineWithOptions, parses the expression and evaluates ResolveName. /u/<name> is unauthenticated, uncached and crawler-reachable, so a scan over random names turns each 404 into a VM eval on a system realm where it previously turned into an early return.
candidates.verify_by: measure node-side rather than over the wire: benchmark a GET /u/zzznotauser against gnoweb's in-memory node (gno.land/pkg/gnoweb app_test's shared node) at head vs merge base 7916d1dd6, or compare vm/qeval ResolveName(unknown) with vm/qrender on an absent path under a local node's gas meter.
candidates.evidence: Live over rpc.gno.land the difference is inside network noise, so it does not settle the node-side cost: vm/qeval ResolveName("zzznotauser") 0.953/0.842/1.002/0.743/0.962 s; vm/qrender gno.land/r/zzznotauser/home: 0.919/0.897/0.758/0.918/0.958 s.
